verdict.rationale: Brevo documents its own contact-list import, but only as a programmatic (API) capability. Nothing in the evidence shows a guided migration flow from another email platform, or that tags, custom fields, or unsubscribe state carry over. missing for 10: guided/UI import or migration wizard from other platforms, documented preservation of tags, custom-field mapping, unsubscribe/suppression state handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can migrate in from another email platform with guided list import that preserves tags, custom fields, and unsubscribe state

citations.quote: Import, update, and organize your contact lists programmatically.
